During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], an '''RX-series pilot droid''' served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The [[Pilot droid/Legends|pilot droid]] had its [[Memory bank/Legends|memory banks]] reprogrammed by the [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]]. Afterward, the [[RX-series pilot droid/Legends|RX unit]] was freed of corrupt and disorganized data and could thus run more efficiently.
